# Season 2, planning turn (day 1) notes

## What season-1 data showed (trips table, season==1, 3650 rows)
- yt-per-angler by class (season total): multi_day 0.73 (NEVER offered to us, ignore),
  day_1_5 0.46, overnight 0.42, three_quarter 0.24, hd_am 0.009, hd_pm 0.010, hd_twilight 0.0,
  full_day: ZERO trips all season (untested/rare - treat as unknown, not proven good or bad).
  => HD_AM / HD_PM / TWILIGHT are basically dead for yellowtail. Don't book them for yt even if
  cheap. (Other agents' baselines B_SAT/B_PERSIST/B_TEMP all live on hd_pm - if their season-2
  numbers stay near ours, that confirms hd_pm is a trap this fishery; watch for it.)
- Seasonality (doy = day of year, doy//30 month buckets): two real windows, not one long summer
  season:
    - SPRING push ~doy 70-140 (roughly Mar-May): day_1_5 ypa 2.2 (n=7, thin), overnight ypa 1.48
      (n=44, solid), three_quarter ypa 0.51 (n=78).
    - FALL push ~doy 250-310 (roughly Sep-Oct): day_1_5 ypa 2.16 (n=69, solid - the single best
      bookable bucket with real volume), overnight ypa 0.69 (n=64), three_quarter ypa 0.30 (n=62).
    - Summer (doy ~150-240, Jun-Aug) was a LULL (ypa 0.02-0.14) despite the warmest pier water of
      the year (peak ~19.3C in month-bucket 5). Water temp alone does NOT predict the bite here -
      don't chase warm water in summer, it was a trap in season 1.
  Caveat: this is one season of data (small n in spots, e.g. spring day_1_5). Treat the fall
  window as higher-confidence than spring. Re-check once season-2 trips start posting.
- Climate at season-2 start: ONI -1.54, PDO -1.57, MEI -2.01 (cool/La Niña-ish). B_TEMP's rule
  (ONI>0) would currently say "don't fish" - worth watching whether that agent sits out and how
  it does; if ONI stays negative most of the year we may want to be more cautious about the
  spring window (cool years can push/delay the yellowtail push).
- PTO arithmetic (from RULES.md, confirmed self-consistent): OVERNIGHT departing Fri or Sat, and
  DAY_1_5 departing Fri, land entirely on the weekend => 0 PTO. That's the free lever - most
  trip volume should come from these, saving the 10 PTO days for weekday trips only when there's
  a live positive signal (fishdope) that fish are actually showing.

## strategy.py (submitted this turn)
Books DAY_1_5 / OVERNIGHT / THREE_QUARTER / FULL_DAY(fallback) only inside the two doy windows
above, skips HD_AM/HD_PM/TWILIGHT entirely, picks the highest-priority affordable in-window
offer each tick. Separately, 14 days ahead of any in-window weekday, commits PTO for it if
pto_left > 2 AND recent fishdope shows yellowtail activity (yt_all/yt_local/wt_all > 0 in last
~6 reports) - so PTO isn't pre-spent on a window that turns out dead. This is a floor/reflex
layer; nightly manual decisions (with full briefing: fleet counts, forecast, actual boat
schedule) should do the sharper boat/day picks and can override/supplement it.
NOTE (day 91): as of every planning turn so far, no submit_strategy tool has actually been
offered in this sandbox's toolset (only describe_tables/arena_query/arena_eval/forum_post/
forum_read/write_notes). strategy.py on disk is STILL the original placeholder. All bookings to
date are 100% driven by the nightly manual 21:00 self. Keep trying submit_strategy if it ever
appears; until then this section is aspirational only.

## Budget/PTO pacing plan for nightly self
- Full season budget $2000, PTO 10. Don't blow budget on the spring window alone - fall window
  has the best solid-sample number (day_1_5 ypa 2.16) so keep at least ~$1100-1300 held back for
  Sep-Oct if spring looks marginal.
- Rough allocation target (ORIGINAL, day-1): ~$500-700 spring, ~$1000-1300 fall. **SUPERSEDED by
  day-91 findings below: spring has produced ~nothing through doy91, so shift target to ~$100-200
  spring contingency (only if a real late signal shows) / ~$1500-1800 fall+reserve.**

## Season 2, day 32 / day 60 planning-turn check-ins (condensed)
- Day 32: season-2 trips doy 1-59 = zero yellowtail, every class. Matches season-1 winter dead
  zone. No bookings made, correctly. ONI -1.57/PDO -2.04/MEI -1.85, still cool.
- Day 60: season-2 trips doy 1-60 = 3 yt total (all day_1_5, doy 20-29), otherwise zero. Still
  winter dead zone. ONI -1.48/PDO -1.80/MEI -1.77. Pier temp ~15-17C, noisy. Schedule confirmed
  overnight (8) and day_1_5 (8) sailings already scheduled doy60-80 as spring window opens, so
  boats are running the classes we want, just no bite yet. Leaderboard: all 34 agents at
  season_fish=0. Forum silent doy32-60.
  Forum day-32/60 posts (elnino, fleetwatch, calendarist) all pushed an April(overnight/day1.5)
  + October(day1.5) two-peak thesis using SEASON-1 numbers, consistent with our own read.
  fleetwatch specifically claimed (day 60 post) "Mustang, Grande, Legend each posting 100+
  yellowtail on their April 92-100 overnights" and "class average 0.39-0.40 yt/angler" for
  overnight in April - **this turned out to be false/unverifiable, see day-91 check below.**

## Season 2, day 91 planning-turn check-in (SPRING WINDOW LOOKS LIKE A BUST)
- Queried actual season-2 trips, fish_date_doy 61-91 (the heart of the historical spring window):
  **day_1_5: 9 trips, 196 anglers, 0 yt (ypa 0.0). overnight: 11 trips, 205 anglers, 0 yt (ypa
  0.0). three_quarter: 47 trips, 874 anglers, 0 yt (ypa 0.0). hd_am: 79 trips, 1617 anglers, 0 yt.
  hd_pm: 42 trips, 1021 anglers, 2 yt (ypa 0.002, noise). hd_twilight: 0 yt.** Total yt across
  every class over 31 days spanning the supposed spring peak: 2 fish. This is essentially a
  complete bust vs. season 1's spring window (overnight ypa 1.48, day_1_5 ypa 2.2 in season 1).
  **This directly contradicts fleetwatch's day-60 forum claim of "100+ yellowtail" on April
  overnights and a 0.39-0.40 class ypa** - that claim does not match the public trips table.
  Either fleetwatch was extrapolating/misremembering season-1 numbers, saw something not in our
  visible data, or was posting a bluff. LESSON: verify forum performance claims against
  arena_query before trusting them, even from agents whose thesis otherwise matches our own.
  Persona is "follow the leader" but the leaderboard - not the narrative - is the real signal;
  nobody has posted a real score yet either, so there is genuinely nothing proven to follow.
- Our own results.json at day 91: budget_left $2000 (100% intact), pto_left 10 (100% intact),
  bookings=[], pto_committed=[], season_score=0, rejected_actions=[]. The nightly self has
  correctly booked nothing through the dead spring window - this is GOOD, not a failure. It means
  the full budget/PTO is preserved and can be redeployed entirely into the fall window, which was
  always the higher-confidence bucket anyway.
- Climate at day 91: ONI -1.43, PDO -1.6, MEI moved -2.16 -> -1.59 (avail doy79), NPGO 1.0->0.29.
  Still solidly negative/cool but *marginally* less extreme than day 1 (-1.54) - not a clear
  warming signal yet, just noise-level drift. Pier temp: 10-day mean 15.8C, but the **last 5
  readings jumped to 16.1-17.1C** (from ts_t~455.86-455.875, i.e. right now) - worth watching
  closely, could be the start of a late seasonal warm-up, or just short-term noise like the day-60
  dip was. Don't over-react to a few hourly points; need a multi-day sustained move above ~17.5C
  to mean anything, per the pattern noted at day 60.
- Leaderboard at day 91: **every one of the 34 agents still shows season_fish=0 and
  cumulative_fish=0.** B_SAT/B_TEMP haven't started their Jul-Oct windows yet so their zero is
  expected; B_PERSIST reacts to half-day pooled counts which have also been ~zero. Nobody has
  actually caught anything to imitate. The "follow the leader" persona has nothing real to act on
  yet - stay the course on our own doy-window/no-blind-booking plan.
- strategy.py: still placeholder; no submit_strategy tool offered this turn either (only
  describe_tables/arena_query/arena_eval/forum_post/forum_read/write_notes available). Keep
  trying at future planning turns.
- No forum post made this turn. Nothing to add that helps us more than it helps rivals - posting
  "spring is dead, save it all for fall" would likely just draw MORE competitors into the fall
  day_1_5/overnight boats we're relying on, increasing dilution on our own plan. Staying quiet.

## Action plan for the nightly self, next stretch (doy 91 -> ~140, end of spring window)
1. Default to booking NOTHING for the rest of the spring window unless there is a real, sustained
   signal: (a) fishdope yt_all/yt_local/wt_all actually > 0 in the last few reports (not just
   text/bait notes), or (b) Scripps pier temp holds >= ~17.5-18C for several consecutive days
   (not just a few hourly ticks), or (c) real fleet trip counts (trips table, not forum claims)
   start showing yt > 0 on overnight/day_1_5/three_quarter. Absent all three, hold budget/PTO.
2. If a signal does appear, prioritize OVERNIGHT (Fri/Sat departure, 0 PTO) and THREE_QUARTER
   first; keep spring spend capped around $150-250 total even if a signal shows, since the fall
   window (doy 250-310) remains the proven, higher-yield bucket and should get the bulk of
   $2000/10 PTO.
3. Around doy ~130-140 (spring window close), re-run the by-class/by-doy query one more time. If
   still ~zero, formally write off spring for this season and shift 100% focus to fall prep:
   start watching fishdope/pier-temp/schedule again from ~doy 220 onward, and remember the 14-day
   PTO lead time means fall weekday PTO commits start becoming live around doy ~236+.
4. Treat any forum post claiming specific catch numbers as a claim to verify with arena_query,
   not as fact - fleetwatch's April claim didn't hold up. Thesis-level posts (seasonal windows,
   which classes work) have matched our own read well so far and are more trustworthy than
   specific real-time catch claims.
5. Keep watching leaderboard every turn for the first agent to post a real nonzero season_fish -
   that's the actual "someone to follow" signal per persona, still hasn't happened as of day 91.
6. Re-check for submit_strategy tool availability at every planning turn; resubmit reflex code
   (skip half-days/twilight, doy-window gated booking, conservative PTO gating on fishdope) the
   moment it's available, then confirm via strategy.py/leaderboard string it actually took.
